<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_733168_aes_announcement_category</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="x_733168_aes_announcement_category">nameISNOTEMPTY^EQ<item endquery="false" field="name" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="ISNOTEMPTY" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Generate Category Internal Name</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /* null when async */) {

    var baseName = current.name
        .toString()
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .normalize('NFD')
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_')
        .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '');

    var internalName = baseName;
    var suffix = 2;

    while (internalNameExists(internalName)) {
        internalName = baseName + '_' + suffix;
        suffix++;
    }

    current.internal_name = internalName;


    function internalNameExists(value) {
        var grCategory = new GlideRecord(current.getTableName());
        grCategory.addQuery('internal_name', value);
        grCategory.setLimit(1);
        grCategory.query();

        return grCategory.hasNext();
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-19 03:37:44</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>396670ab93d78b50ef30f2918bba105e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Generate Category Internal Name</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Announcement Experience Suite" source="x_733168_aes">69255b1793db4b50ef30f2918bba10d5</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Announcement Experience Suite">69255b1793db4b50ef30f2918bba10d5</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_396670ab93d78b50ef30f2918bba105e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-19 03:46:22</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=396670ab93d78b50ef30f2918bba105e"/></record_update>
